calculation.expression: log(close_t / close_{t-10}) / rolling_std_40(log_returns where return < 0, min_periods=20), shifted by 1 session
calculation.description: Ranks assets by their lagged 10-day log momentum scaled by 40-day downside volatility; higher values indicate stronger momentum achieved with lower downside risk.

validation.regime_notes: Passed the shared absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840 gates at the 5-day horizon. Ten-day IC was 0.021281 with ICIR 0.057296 and therefore did not pass at the portfolio cadence. Five-day thirds show strong early performance and weak recent performance; interpret conservatively given average cross-section near the 8-name minimum.
